item.title: Why Knowing Vocabulary Doesn't Mean You Can Speak: Fixing the Intermediate Pronunciation Plateau
item.description: Adult self-learners often stall out because textbook study misses the physical mechanics of accent and native rhythm.

item.title: Why Knowing Vocabulary Doesn't Mean You Can Speak a Second Language
item.description: Traditional apps teach you what words mean, but they rarely train your mouth to form the sounds correctly.
